sentences.en: A book is only excusable so far as it teaches something.
sentences.zh: 这本书只在传授知识的范围内可以被原谅。

sentences.en: Human nature is excusable when it errs.
sentences.zh: 人性出错是可以理解的。

sentences.en: His late arrival was excusable because of the heavy traffic.
sentences.zh: 他因为交通堵塞而迟到是可以原谅的。

senses.zh: 可原谅的；可辩解的；可免除的
